compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, institutional HPC 12 lanes, ~6 min wall for 27 cells. Theory-motivated by Round-10 Pre-Equilibrium Saturation Theorem derivation.
grid: r in {4,16,64} x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds = 27 cells
mechanism_implication: Confidence-on-target weighting does not break positive-feedback loop on our finetune data because pretrained's confident-on-target is rare. This rules out one specific operationalization of the loss-weighting axis. Different operationalization (weight by entropy or by argmax-confidence) tested in K15t.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: fire-rate <27/27 + final-loss bounded. PARTIAL: fire-step >20. DOESN'T: fire 27/27 + fire-step ~11.
schema: K15s confidence-aware loss weighting: weight masked-CE per masked position by (1 - p_pretrained(target|x))^W with W=1.0. Theory-motivated intervention to break positive-feedback at confident-pretrained-target positions. MDLM-OWT 130M, 27 cells.
verdict_explanation: DOESN'T: fire 27/27, paired fire-step delta 0, paired max-grad ratio 1.04, paired final-loss delta +0.04. Confidence-aware loss weighting essentially a no-op at W=1.0 because on finetune corpus, pretrained p(target|x) is typically LOW (target tokens are not in pretrained's confident-predictions), so weights ~1 everywhere. Implementation matches theoretical sketch but the weights collapse to ~baseline on the data we tested. Possible v2 fix: weight by (1 - p_pretrained(argmax|x)) instead, but this is a different theoretical mechanism.
